## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!teams` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html, htmlJson } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const data = {
  "title": "Futsal night",
  "names": [
    "Ari",
    "Bima",
    "Citra",
    "Dewi",
    "Eka",
    "Fajar",
    "Gita",
    "Hana",
    "Indra",
    "Joko"
  ]
}

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --orange: #ff8a3d; --yellow: #ffc93c; --lime: #9be15d; --mint: #2ed8a7; --sky: #38b6ff; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --soft: #5b4a86; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--yellow) 0%, var(--orange) 100%); color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 12px 14px 14px; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
  main { height: 100%; max-width: 440px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
  header { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-height: 30px; }
  h1 { margin: 0; min-width: 0; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .badge { flex: none; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
  .screen { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
  .screen[hidden] { display: none; }
  button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
  button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }

  .panel { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 10px 10px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--cream); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .22); }
  .hint { flex: none; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--soft); }
  .chips { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-content: flex-start; gap: 6px; }
  .chip { max-width: 100%; height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 6px 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .25); animation: chipIn .25s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .5, 1); }
  .chip span { max-width: 8em; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .chip i { flex: none; width: 22px; height: 22px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--pink); font-style: normal; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; }
  .chip:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: none; }
  .chip[hidden] { display: none; }
  .chip.more { padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; border: 2px dashed var(--ink); box-shadow: none; }
  .empty { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--soft); padding: 6px 2px; }
  @keyframes chipIn { from { transform: scale(.6); } to { transform: scale(1); } }

  .row { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font: 700 15px system-ui, sans-serif; user-select: text; -webkit-user-select: text; }
  input::placeholder { color: #6f6390; }
  .soft { flex: none; min-width: 42px; height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .35); }
  .soft:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .35); }
  .soft:disabled { opacity: .45; box-shadow: none; cursor: default; transform: none; }
  .teams { justify-content: space-between; padding: 3px 3px 3px 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255, 248, 236, .6); }
  .teams b { display: block; font-size: 15px; line-height: 19px; font-weight: 800; }
  .teams small { display: block; min-height: 15px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); white-space: nowrap; }
  .step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
  .step output { min-width: 26px; text-align: center; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .step .soft { font-size: 20px; padding: 0; }
  .primary { flex: none; width: 100%; min-height: 46px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--sky); color: var(--ink); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #1f7fc0; transition: transform .1s, box-shadow .1s; }
  .primary:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #1f7fc0; }
  .primary:disabled { background: #d9e6ee; box-shadow: none; cursor: default; transform: none; }
  #status { flex: none; min-height: 16px; margin: 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

  .grid { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
  .card { min-width: 0; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--cream); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .25); }
  .card.reveal { animation: reveal .45s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1) both; }
  @keyframes reveal { from { transform: scale(.5) rotate(-6deg); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1) rotate(0); opacity: 1; } }
  .card h2 { flex: none; margin: 0; padding: 5px 10px 5px; background: var(--c); font-size: 15px; line-height: 19px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .card h2 small { display: block; font-size: 12px; line-height: 15px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .card ul { flex: 1; min-height: 0; margin: 0; padding: 4px 10px 6px; list-style: none; overflow: hidden; }
  .card li { height: 20px; line-height: 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .card li.extra { color: var(--soft); font-size: 13px; }
  .card.reveal li { animation: nameIn .3s ease-out both; }
  @keyframes nameIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .chip, .card.reveal, .card.reveal li { animation: none; }
  }
</style>
<main>
  <header>
    <h1 id="title">Team picker</h1>
    <span class="badge">🎲 Random</span>
  </header>

  <section class="screen" id="setup">
    <div class="panel">
      <div class="hint" id="hint">Players · tap a name to remove it</div>
      <div class="chips" id="chips"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <input id="name" type="text" inputmode="text" enterkeyhint="done" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="words" maxlength="20" placeholder="Add a name" aria-label="Add a name">
      <button type="button" class="soft" id="add">Add</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row teams">
      <div><b>Teams</b><small id="per"></small></div>
      <div class="step">
        <button type="button" class="soft" id="fewer" aria-label="Fewer teams">−</button>
        <output id="teamCount" aria-live="polite">2</output>
        <button type="button" class="soft" id="moreTeams" aria-label="More teams">+</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="primary" id="shuffle">Shuffle teams</button>
  </section>

  <section class="screen" id="result" hidden>
    <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
    <div class="row">
      <button type="button" class="soft" id="edit">Edit names</button>
      <button type="button" class="primary" id="again" style="flex: 1; width: auto">Shuffle again</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <p id="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</main>
<script>
  var DATA = ${htmlJson(data)};
  var TEXT = { title: 'Team picker', players: ' players', player: ' player', hint: 'Players · tap a name to remove it', empty: 'No names yet. Add one below.', more: ' more', added: 'Added ', removed: 'Removed ', dup: ' is already on the list', full: 'The list is full', need: 'Add at least ', needEnd: ' names to make teams', perTeam: ' per team', split: 'Random split: ', team: 'Team ' };
  var EXAMPLE = ['Player 1', 'Player 2', 'Player 3', 'Player 4', 'Player 5', 'Player 6'];
  var TEAM_COLORS = ['#ff4f8b', '#38b6ff', '#2ed8a7', '#9be15d'];
  var TEAM_MARKS = ['★', '●', '▲', '◆'];
  var MIN_TEAMS = 2, MAX_TEAMS = 4, MAX_NAMES = 60, MAX_LEN = 20;

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function tidy(v, max) { return String(v == null ? '' : v).split(' ').filter(Boolean).join(' ').slice(0, max || MAX_LEN); }

  // Unbiased integer in [0, n) from the crypto generator.
  function randInt(n) {
    var limit = Math.floor(4294967296 / n) * n, buf = new Uint32Array(1);
    if (!window.crypto || !crypto.getRandomValues) return Math.floor(Math.random() * n);
    do { crypto.getRandomValues(buf); } while (buf[0] >= limit);
    return buf[0] % n;
  }

  function shuffled(list) {
    var a = list.slice();
    for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      var j = randInt(i + 1), t = a[i];
      a[i] = a[j];
      a[j] = t;
    }
    return a;
  }

  // Deals the shuffled names round-robin, so team sizes never differ by more than one.
  function makeTeams(list, count) {
    var teams = [], order = shuffled(list);
    for (var t = 0; t < count; t++) teams.push([]);
    for (var i = 0; i < order.length; i++) teams[i % count].push(order[i]);
    return teams;
  }

  var d = DATA || {};
  var names = [];
  (Array.isArray(d.names) ? d.names : EXAMPLE).forEach(function (n) { addName(tidy(n), true); });
  var title = tidy(d.title, 40) || TEXT.title;
  var teamCount = MIN_TEAMS, start = 0, shown = 0;
  var calm = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  $('title').textContent = title;

  function plural(n) { return n + (n === 1 ? TEXT.player : TEXT.players); }
  function say(text) { $('status').textContent = text; }

  function addName(name, quiet) {
    if (!name) return false;
    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
      if (names[i].toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()) { if (!quiet) say(name + TEXT.dup); return false; }
    }
    if (names.length >= MAX_NAMES) { if (!quiet) say(TEXT.full); return false; }
    names.push(name);
    return true;
  }

  function chip(label, cls) {
    var b = document.createElement('button');
    b.type = 'button';
    b.className = cls;
    var s = document.createElement('span');
    s.textContent = label;
    b.appendChild(s);
    return b;
  }

  // Shows as many chips as fit from the start index; a "+K more" chip pages through the rest.
  function renderChips() {
    var box = $('chips');
    box.textContent = '';
    if (start >= names.length) start = 0;
    if (!names.length) {
      var e = document.createElement('div');
      e.className = 'empty';
      e.textContent = TEXT.empty;
      box.appendChild(e);
      shown = 0;
      return;
    }
    var items = [];
    for (var i = start; i < names.length; i++) {
      var c = chip(names[i], 'chip');
      var x = document.createElement('i');
      x.textContent = '×';
      x.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      c.appendChild(x);
      c.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Remove ' + names[i]);
      c.addEventListener('click', remove.bind(null, i));
      box.appendChild(c);
      items.push(c);
    }
    shown = items.length;
    var more = chip('', 'chip more');
    more.addEventListener('click', function () {
      start += shown;
      if (start >= names.length) start = 0;
      renderChips();
    });
    function label() {
      var hidden = names.length - shown;
      more.firstChild.textContent = '+' + hidden + TEXT.more;
      more.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Show ' + hidden + ' more names');
      more.hidden = hidden === 0;
    }
    label();
    box.appendChild(more);
    while (box.scrollHeight > box.clientHeight + 1 && shown > 1) {
      box.removeChild(items[--shown]);
      label();
    }
  }

  function render() {
    var n = names.length;
    $('hint').textContent = plural(n) + ' · tap a name to remove it';
    $('teamCount').textContent = String(teamCount);
    $('fewer').disabled = teamCount <= MIN_TEAMS;
    $('moreTeams').disabled = teamCount >= MAX_TEAMS;
    var enough = n >= teamCount;
    $('shuffle').disabled = !enough;
    $('per').textContent = enough ? Math.floor(n / teamCount) + (n % teamCount ? '–' + Math.ceil(n / teamCount) : '') + TEXT.perTeam : 'Need ' + teamCount + '+ names';
    renderChips();
    return enough;
  }

  function remove(i) {
    var gone = names.splice(i, 1)[0];
    render();
    say(TEXT.removed + gone + ' · ' + plural(names.length));
    var chips = $('chips').querySelectorAll('.chip:not(.more)');
    if (chips.length) chips[Math.max(0, Math.min(i - start, chips.length - 1))].focus(); else $('name').focus();
  }

  function submitName() {
    var input = $('name'), name = tidy(input.value);
    if (!name) return;
    if (!addName(name, false)) return;
    input.value = '';
    // Page forward until the new name is on screen.
    for (var guard = 0; guard < names.length; guard++) {
      render();
      if (names.length - 1 < start + shown) break;
      start += shown;
    }
    say(TEXT.added + name + ' · ' + plural(names.length));
  }

  function showTeams() {
    if (!render()) { say(TEXT.need + teamCount + TEXT.needEnd); return; }
    var teams = makeTeams(names, teamCount), grid = $('grid');
    $('setup').hidden = true;
    $('result').hidden = false;
    grid.textContent = '';
    var cols = teamCount === 4 ? 2 : teamCount;
    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(' + cols + ', minmax(0, 1fr))';
    grid.style.gridTemplateRows = 'repeat(' + Math.ceil(teamCount / cols) + ', minmax(0, 1fr))';
    var lists = [];
    teams.forEach(function (members, t) {
      var card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = calm ? 'card' : 'card reveal';
      card.style.setProperty('--c', TEAM_COLORS[t]);
      card.style.animationDelay = (t * 0.09) + 's';
      var h = document.createElement('h2');
      h.textContent = TEAM_MARKS[t] + ' ' + TEXT.team + (t + 1);
      var count = document.createElement('small');
      count.textContent = plural(members.length);
      h.appendChild(count);
      card.appendChild(h);
      var ul = document.createElement('ul');
      card.appendChild(ul);
      grid.appendChild(card);
      lists.push({ ul: ul, members: members, delay: t * 0.09 });
    });
    lists.forEach(function (l) {
      var fit = Math.max(1, Math.floor((l.ul.clientHeight - 10) / 20));
      var visible = l.members.length > fit ? fit - 1 : l.members.length;
      for (var i = 0; i < visible; i++) {
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        li.textContent = l.members[i];
        li.style.animationDelay = (l.delay + 0.2 + i * 0.05) + 's';
        l.ul.appendChild(li);
      }
      if (visible < l.members.length) {
        var extra = document.createElement('li');
        extra.className = 'extra';
        extra.textContent = '+' + (l.members.length - visible) + TEXT.more;
        extra.style.animationDelay = (l.delay + 0.2 + visible * 0.05) + 's';
        l.ul.appendChild(extra);
      }
    });
    say(TEXT.split + teams.map(function (m) { return m.length; }).join(' / ') + ' · ' + plural(names.length));
    $('again').focus();
  }

  $('add').addEventListener('click', function () { submitName(); $('name').focus(); });
  $('name').addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); submitName(); } });
  $('fewer').addEventListener('click', function () { if (teamCount > MIN_TEAMS) { teamCount--; render(); } });
  $('moreTeams').addEventListener('click', function () { if (teamCount < MAX_TEAMS) { teamCount++; render(); } });
  $('shuffle').addEventListener('click', showTeams);
  $('again').addEventListener('click', showTeams);
  $('edit').addEventListener('click', function () {
    $('result').hidden = true;
    $('setup').hidden = false;
    render();
    say(plural(names.length) + ' · ' + teamCount + ' teams');
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { if ($('result').hidden) render(); });

  render();
  say(render() ? plural(names.length) + ' · ' + teamCount + ' teams' : TEXT.need + teamCount + TEXT.needEnd);
</script>
`

client.command('teams', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Team picker",
    height: 420,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "The team picker opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
    bypassDownload: false,
  })
})
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Height | 420 px |
| Size | 15.8 KB |
| Input | Tap, Phone keyboard |
| Download prompt | May appear on some accounts: `bypassDownload: false` keeps the card from reloading and losing its state |
| Tested | Not yet tested on a phone |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
